Exceptions: the 20 interns paid WT 62149 are reported with Sueldo 0.00 (Salary Assigned 2,300,000, reported as ApoyoSost), and 2 integral employees are reported with exactly twice their Salary Assigned. Compare as numbers (the file prints 2 decimals).
